From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing watchlist + recent model launches — prep for leadership deck

Team —

As we finalize slides for next week's leadership QBR, I want a concise synthesis of competitor pricing moves and model releases that could materially affect our OKRs (revenue retention, Dedicated conversion, and gross margin). Please read the short bullets below and add updates inline in the Drive doc (link at bottom).

Quick summary (what I know right now):
- VectorAI announced a pay-as-you-go pricing tier yesterday with aggressive token tiers for retrieval-heavy apps — likely to impact startups shifting off rented GPUs.
- OpenWeights pushed v2.1 of their opensource family with a new 7B variant optimized for low-latency CPU inference (claiming 2x throughput vs prior).
- A smaller ML shop posted a case study showing better cost-per-inference using custom KV caching; interesting signal but not widely adopted yet.

Asks:
1) Markus — can you give a two-slide impact estimate on Dedicated pipeline (cost delta, churn risk) by Friday EOD? Use the pricing-comparison workbook I attached.
2) Aditya — compile a brief note on whether any of our recommended quantization/packing profiles should be updated in Optimize (tie to OKR: reduce per-token cost 12%).
3) Laura — include any customer feedback from renewals calls that mention competitor offers (region: US & EU).
4) Evelyn — please pull any relevant ticket spikes in the last 30 days that mention third-party model fallbacks.

I've attached a raw pricing-comparison workbook and a competitor timeline brief to start. I'll pull these into the QBR deck but want your bullets by Friday so we can finalize.

Thanks — Maya

--
Maya Srinivasan
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing watchlist + recent model launches — prep for leadership deck

Maya — thanks, digging in. Early notes below; I'll convert to slides by Friday.

- VectorAI PAYG: pricing looks targeted at inference-heavy startups using hosted endpoints. If they convert mid-market customers it could pressure our self-serve Hosted ARPU. Short-term risk: low (most enterprise deals are still SLA/visibility driven). Medium-term: moderate if they broaden to committed reserved discounts.
- OpenWeights v2.1: this is the real one to watch. A 7B CPU-optimized variant reduces barrier to entry for teams who can't afford GPUs; could slow some Dedicated renewals for smaller accounts.
- Where we can win: observability, rollouts, and strict throughput SLAs. If a competitor sells cheaper per-token but no SLA or private deployment, our Dedicated + Private messaging should be clearer.

Action items I'll include on the slide:
- Short-term mitigations: adjust messaging on Dedicated page to highlight latency SLOs and model pinning; propose a temporary promotional credit for mid-market renewals as a defensive test.
- Metrics to show: number of Dedicated customers with <100K tokens/day (possible churn cohort), Hosted ARPU delta if 10% of self-serve moves. I've added a tab in the workbook with cohort definitions.

Markus

--
Markus Klein

Maya — I've run quick sims against our most common quant/pack profiles. Short summary:
- For retrieval-heavy workloads, VectorAI's PAYG pricing undercuts our default Hosted per-token cost at very high volumes (>2M tokens/month) for small models. That said, when accounting for request-level latency (and our prefix/KV caching), our effective per-inference cost is still within close range.
- OpenWeights v2.1: no immediate change to our Optimize defaults, but we should add a recommended profile for CPU-edge deployments and call it out in our docs if customers plan to self-host.

Attached: a one-page memo and a short chart. I'll merge my sims into the Drive workbook (tab:optimize-impact).

Plan suggestion (for slides):
- Competitive posture: emphasize reliability + Private option for regulated customers, call out lower TCO in Dedicated for sustained high throughput.
- Tactical: propose a 30-day promotional credit (Hosted) targeted at churn-risk cohort for the end of August.

Aditya
